entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The applicants Virendra Singh and Bobby Sharma seeks anticipatory bail in Complaint Case No.391 of 2022, dated 26.09.2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 504, 506 IPC, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate/Civil Judge (Jr. Div.), Doiwala, District Dehradun ("the case").
2.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3. In the case, on 19.05.2023, the applicants have been summoned to answer the accusation under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 504, 506 IPC.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants would submit that the summons were never been served to the applicants.
5. Issue notice to the respondent no.2, returnable within six weeks.
Steps to be taken within a week.
6. State as well as respondent no.2 to file objections.

Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail subject to their furnishing personal bond and two sureties, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following:-
(i) The applicants shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, the victim or/and any of the witness in the case.
